note: RV park and marina at 20 Park Avenue in Manistee, on the Manistee River where it meets Manistee Lake, with boat access to Lake Michigan: waterfront, pull-through, full-hookup, water/electric and primitive sites, rental units, 50 marina slips, a boat ramp and a fish-cleaning station. The operator's posted hours show it closed for remodeling Nov 1, 2026 - Jan 1, 2027, reopening Jan 2 (read 2026-10-22). --Claude
